d:
Rahul Gandhi Delhi Rally :dilli ke ramlila maidan men kal INDIA gathbandhan ki bari raili hone ja rahi hai. is raili men jharkhand ke mukhyamantri hemant soren aur svasthy mantri irphan ansari bhi shamil honge. raili se pahle jharkhand ki rajniti men bhi halchal tej ho gaee hai.
Aakhir dilli ki is raili men vipaksh kin muddon ko uthaega? hemant soren aur irphan ansari ki maujudgi ke kya siyasi mayne hain? dekhie is riport men puri khabra.
Jharkhand aur desh ki rajniti se juri har bari khabar aur apdet ke lie hamare chainal ko sabsakraib karen.
